name: Bé Chuille
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: an Irish goddess of the Tuatha Dé Danann
magical daughter of the goddess Flidais
able to combat the wicked sorceress Carman

text: Bé Chuille is an Irish goddess of the Tuatha Dé Danann. She was the magical child of Flidais, the woodland goddess. She alone among the Tuatha Dé Danann could fight the wicked sorceress Carman. Her skill made her a valued defender of her people.

okr.objective: Describe Bé Chuille, the magical daughter of Flidais who combated Carman.
key_results: Bé Chuille belonged to the Tuatha Dé Danann.
She was the magical daughter of the goddess Flidais.
She alone could fight the wicked sorceress Carman.
